category: short category, e.g. frameworks, patterns, adoption, benchmarks
question: A single, specific, binary or clearly-scoped question — must be checkable, not vibes.
resolution_date: YYYY-MM-DD — when this gets checked against reality
resolution_criteria: Exactly what public, checkable fact resolves this true/false. If you can't write this precisely, the question isn't specific enough yet.
reasoning: 2-4 sentences on why this probability, referencing what you actually found in research.
